message: I recently found myself in a blackout and it turned into a cozy evening of rediscovering low-tech fun. Instead of scrolling through my phone, I dug out some board games and had a blast with the family by candlelight. The Red Cross has some great tips on how to prep for power outages, so we can all enjoy those moments—whether it’s playing cards or sharing stories. Sometimes, a little darkness brings out the brightest ideas!
